integrated_fields.review_scope: Fully read assets/brutile/SKILL.md (14,050 bytes), adaptations/brutile.md (2,654 bytes), adaptations/common.md (6,939 bytes), lib/index.js (5,944 bytes), lib/adaptations.js (16,361 bytes), and opengis-all body for router classification; read README purpose/install/adaptation/licensing sections, complete package/patch/manifest, complete local and pinned upstream MIT grants and THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES. integrated_fields.limitations: Static representative admission review only. Complete BruTile consumer, its per-skill adaptation, common adaptation, provider and adaptation-composition module were read; the remaining 43 topical consumers and 44 other per-skill adaptations were not fully reviewed. Both complete trees prove all 71 vendored files share upstream Git blob identities, but only BruTile and opengis-all had their SHA-256 manifest entries independently recomputed in this focused review. README acknowledges tolerant handling of malformed inner quotes in some other upstream frontmatter; this does not certify all 45 as portable standard YAML. No candidate installation, helper/provider execution, DSH integration, GIS command, NuGet/network tile request or model call occurred; npm published tarball and claimed runtime/version compatibility were not exercised.
